title: A World of Dark Comedy 5
tagline: 14 unhinged short films from around the world that demonstrate the devious and deranged depths of the human psyche.

films.title: Off-Guard
credits: Co-directors, co-writers & co-producers – Yoav Basori, Harry Phillips & Jake Kuhn
Cast – Gregory David, Levi Mattey, Yoav Basori +
synopsis: Paul, an unsuspecting everyman, spirals into paranoia as he becomes convinced he’s the target of some ruthless gangster’s master plan.
films.quote: “Let’s just call it a special occasion!”

films.title: The Night’s Takings
credits: Cast – Joanna Bakker, Colin J Harte, John Robert Sparring
synopsis: A man steals the night’s takings from the bar he works at, to get back at his employer who has been underpaying him for so long.

films.title: Extreme Gravity
credits: Co-producers – Diego Kataryniuk, Pablo Campillo, Ivan Saldana
synopsis: What would be the worst thing that could happen to you when trying to kill yourself?
films.quote: “Why are you naked on the window of the 6th floor?!”

films.title: Wetwork
credits: Cast – Ron Arthurs, Jason Robert Lester & Codey Finlay
synopsis: The lead engineer of a secret project gets an after-hours visit from the cleaner.

films.title: Safe Streets
synopsis: A police officer and a politician question their relationship to the law when they each commit a crime to satisfy their desires.

films.title: Autographed by God
credits: Cast – Joshua Malloy, Mason Dotson, Bill Doty +
synopsis: Two missionaries meet a man claiming to be God. What should have been a great encounter turns into a fatal ending.

films.title: A Story of Theft
credits: Cast – Nima Imanzadeh, Morteza Darbeheshti & Hossein Ahmadi
synopsis: A tale of two thieves who, in their quest to steal, mistakenly break into the home of a mafia boss.

films.title: Tails from the Wild
credits: Director, Writer, Producer & Animator – Mark Villagracia
synopsis: In this nature mockumentary, we follow an innocuous koala that becomes the most infamous animal in the Australian Outback.
films.quote: “…Proving that some of us just really do fall upwards.”

films.title: Real Love Baby
synopsis: A couple is going through the miraculous process of giving birth, but what they bring into the world is not what they expected. A metaphor on materialism.

films.title: Meister der Scheisse
credits: Director, Writer, Animator & Producer – Anthony Wood
synopsis: An animated German expressionist retelling of the origin story of an infamous, historic buffoon.

films.title: Kill Mick
credits: Cast – Adam Dean, Wilson Zou, Mark Alexander & Morgan Phillips
synopsis: As far as gangs go, taking out the target should be done without weapons of destruction.

films.title: Condom Hunters
credits: Cast – Hiba Chiane, Salma Chalbi, Marc Basset +
synopsis: An incident in a pharmacy reveals that a conservative daughter, a married man, and a sexually active young adult have the same goal: buying a condom!
films.quote: “Now toughen up and go get the condoms.”

films.title: Keepsake
credits: Cast – Charlotte Grimmer, Ethan Jones & Angel Dixon
synopsis: A young woman stumbles upon a special keepsake that she simply cannot let go of.

films.title: Halmoni’s Pot
credits: Director, Writer & Co-producer – A. Lauren Lee
Cast – Alexis Rhee, Haulston Mann, Wesley Han +
synopsis: Grandma Mee-Yung reluctantly agrees to buy pot for her grandson. But pay full price? Never!
